title: Art L Probable NDE 4351
content: I was lying on a bed and sniffing Protrusuin and I stopped breathing. I left my body and was rising above my body. I then had a quick review of my life. I found myself in a very dark place approaching a bright light. As I got closer to this light, I felt at peace, I felt love and knowledge. As I got closer to this bright light, I noticed the silhouettes of people with their backs toward me. As I got closer these two silhouettes, they turned to face me. I knew that they were my great uncle and aunt. I drifted past them as I approached this source of light, which grew brighter. I also felt like I knew the universe. I had an understanding of everything. Someone approached me from this light. It was a holy light, source of all knowledge, love and so much more. A voice said, ' What have you done with the life I given you? Go back now and live your life. Marry and raise children.' As I started to retreat from this person (God, a Creator), I very quickly fell backwards down into my body, which hurt so bad. All the feelings came back. I gasped for air, took a very deep breath, and opened my eyes. I was back in the bed. I remembered everything that happened to me. I thought about what had happened to me for days after it happened. Finely I went to talk to my Priest about what happened. I told him the whole story. He didn't know what to say, tried to explain what it could have been, but had no answer. As time went on, I realized at times I would experience small psychic events. I would visualize in my mind that something was going to happen and seconds later, it would happen. (Someone will walk in a room and say something, and it would happen seconds later.) This slowly faded after a few weeks. From my experience of the NDE my life has changed, I had a different outlook on things and people.
